title: Ice Cream Plus
description: Adds ice cream and other ice cream related things.
body:
A small and simple mod that adds ice cream and ice cream related objects and items.

# Items
1. Ice Cube - Ice cubes are important to the world of ice creams, so why not?
2. Ice Cream Cone - Ice cream cones are used to hold the scoop of ice cream.
3. Scoop of (Flavor) Ice Cream - A scoop of ice cream of different flavors.
4. Ice Cream - Ice cream.

# Advancements
- Freezing (Get an ice cube)
- Preparing Ingredients (Get an ice cream cone)
- I LOVE ICE CREAM (Get all three flavors of ice cream)
